create.name: Liesel Fricke
create.bio:
Liesel Fricke is a mystic and channel who receives messages, teachings and meditations from a collective of nonphysical beings she and her husband call the Beings of Light. Her own path began during more than a decade of intense inner suffering, when the teachings of Eckhart Tolle and mindfulness practice opened her to present-moment awareness and to glimpses of what she describes as Unity Consciousness. She began channelling in 2020, and she presents the Beings of Light as speaking from that state of Oneness.

She teaches together with her husband, Robert Schwartz, author of Your Soul's Plan; they have been married since 2016. Their shared work combines his research into pre-birth planning with the material that comes through her, and they teach online workshops for audiences in several countries, including regular livestreams in English and German. Together they lead Rise to the Path, a monthly membership with live channelled meditations and questions to the Beings of Light, and they have created several self-paced courses for The Shift Network on intuition, spiritual ascension and the purpose of the life planned before birth. Many of her channelled messages are published free on their website.

courses.title: Attune Your Intuition
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course with Rob Schwartz and Liesel Fricke on widening empathic and intuitive ability. It uses meditation, simple energy tools and channelled messages from the Beings of Light, and includes a guided regression to explore the soul's plan.

courses.title: The Spiritual Ascension Program
courses.description: Seven recorded 90-minute sessions on cooperating with the shift in consciousness the teachers call Ascension. Guided meditations, forgiveness and gratitude practices and channelled messages help students see their lives from a soul-level view.

courses.title: Awakening to the Spiritual Purpose of the Life You Planned Before Birth
courses.description: A self-paced course in seven recorded sessions exploring pre-birth planning through guided inner journeys, soul regression and meditation. Students look at the virtues they came to cultivate and at life's challenges as chosen experiences for growth.

courses.title: Rise to the Path: A Membership and Mentorship Program
courses.description: A monthly online membership led by Rob Schwartz and Liesel Fricke, meeting live every third Tuesday. Sessions include channelled meditations and answers from the Beings of Light, with a library of recorded channellings; there is a 30-day free trial.
courses.price: $25 USD/month, $135 USD every 6 months, or $240 USD/year

free_resources.title: Channelings from the Beings of Light
free_resources.description: A free library of short channelled messages from the Beings of Light, received through Liesel Fricke. Topics include ascension, vibration, Gaia and why souls choose contrast.
